sections.title: Osteoimmunology
sections.description: Study of the interface between the skeletal system and the immune system. Examines shared components and interactions between the skeleton (bone) and immune system. Particularly relevant in: Periodontal disease, Orthodontics, Pediatric dentistry, Endodontics, Oral Medicine, Oral Surgery, and Prosthodontics
